facts.fact: Djibouti's Loi n°151/AN/22/8ème L, promulgated 18 July 2022, requires the State in Article 24 to take measures ensuring access to information and communication, including ICT systems and electronic services, for persons with disabilities, and in Article 25 to promulgate minimum national accessibility standards and guidelines.
facts.system: Loi n°151/AN/22/8ème L on the rights of persons with disabilities
